candidate_envelope_probe.scope: broad FederalRegister API feasibility union only

source_contract.claim_scope: complete only under the frozen FederalRegister API search envelope; not a full-corpus semantic census or recall claim
authority_hierarchy: GovInfo collection sitemap for expected issue packages
FederalRegister.gov API for candidate document discovery and metadata reconciliation only
official GovInfo granule MODS and HTML for metadata and exact membership
official GovInfo granule PDF retained as archival/legal authority

bulk_xml.reason: derived nonofficial rendition with observed parse anomalies

issue_inventory.weekend_holiday_rule: only sealed sitemap packages exist; never infer calendar dates

candidate_discovery.pagination: reconstruct integer page=1..total_pages for every query
candidate_discovery.api_false_negative_scope: a GovInfo exact-term document not proposed by the frozen query union is outside NFET-v1 and cannot support a full-corpus claim

official_document.all_candidate_retention: content-addressed deterministic compressed search page, MODS, raw HTML, canonical visible text, and detail JSON
official_document.positive_additional_retention: content-addressed GovInfo PDF plus exact match records
official_document.reason_raw_html_is_not_identity: edge email-obfuscation attributes can vary while visible text is stable

disk.check: before every response download on the output filesystem

source_contract.revision_rule: changed previously sealed sitemap, search, MODS, canonical text, or pdf bytes halt NFET; never rebuild history in place

mods.other_format_rule: exactly two unique xlink href values: HTML and PDF

parser_contract.text_order: all other handle_data fragments in document order
parser_contract.control_rule: replace code points whose Unicode category starts C with ASCII space
parser_contract.whitespace_rule: Python Unicode \s+ collapsed to one ASCII space, then strip

agency_contract.normalization: Unicode NFKC; str.upper; category-C to space; collapse whitespace
agency_contract.set_rule: sorted unique nonempty set; duplicate name is fatal
agency_contract.primary: all positive documents without the SEC name
agency_contract.concentration: each k-agency primary document contributes 1/k to each name

required_equalities: candidate document_number == GovInfo MODS FR Doc No. identifier
candidate publication_date == GovInfo MODS host dateIssued
GovInfo MODS host URI == predictable issue details URL
GovInfo MODS otherFormat links == predictable HTML and PDF URLs
detail pdf_url == predictable GovInfo PDF URL
identity_and_reconciliation.correction_rule: record correction_of and corrections; correction remains a new document at its own availability and never mutates the original

availability_contract.live: max(historical floor, durable local receipt + parse + hash + reconciliation + manifest commit)
availability_contract.event_deduplication: one source event per primary publication date

novelty_gates.source_clock: one event per unique primary publication date at D+1 12:00 UTC
novelty_gates.comparator_bindings: paths, schemas, common coverage, and SHA-256 values must be committed in a later outcome-blind novelty access seal
novelty_gates.matching: within common coverage sort unique UTC entries; visit primary entries chronologically and match the unused comparator entry with minimum absolute distance, ties toward the earlier comparator

later_model_boundary.allowed_later: single quote-grounded Gemma extractor/classifier then train-only RLLM gate
forbidden: source event creation deletion or retiming
eval reward for prompt adapter or checkpoint selection

rejection_contract: any source hierarchy, inventory, pagination, official-text, agency, identity, reconciliation, disk, quality, or novelty failure retires NFET without changing queries, terms, dates, parser, SEC routing, availability, thresholds, or comparators
